dct_description_sm:
Plot-level replication data for the journal article "Total uptake and grain mineral nutrient concentrations in winter wheat: effects of nitrogen supply, fungicide and cultivar" published in Field Crops Research. The dataset consists of two files:

    1) "wheat_nutrient_accumulation_maturity.csv": Total aboveground uptake at physiological maturity (Zadoks GS92) of Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Sulfur, Calcium, Magnesium, Boron, Copper, Managanese, and Zinc.
    2) "wheat_grain_nutrient_concentrations.csv": grain concentrations at harvest maturity of the same ten nutrients.
From all 12 environments (location-years) included in the study, and as influenced by all imposed treatments (nitrogen rate, fungicide use, winter wheat cultivar). Metadata is found in an associated README.txt file.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Total uptake and grain mineral nutrient concentrations in winter wheat: effects of nitrogen supply, fungicide and cultivar
